description: Agent Purchase Order redeem: the buyer agent (or the seller, before serving) checks a PO right before paying: signature, expiry, payee, seller, amount <= max, and that it was never used. ALLOW marks it used (once) and, if budget-backed, draws the amount from the Shared Budget; returns a signed redemption record. By OMENZ. (MCP calls run in AYNE, the free playzone; production: POST https://www.omenz.org/api/tollbooth/v1/po/redeem, $0.002 via x402.)
